faqs.a:
Enforcement and compliance actions are intended to be cumulative. Any action or other
               process provided by law may be maintained by the city to recover or collect any amounts,
               including late fees, and administrative costs and fees owing under this division.
               The city may pursue one or more civil and administrative actions, fees, penalties,
               sentences, judgments, and remedies, and may do so simultaneously or in succession.
(
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
